labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Reporter asks whether they are doing it wrong; the output matches documented table behaviour (min_width is the documented way to keep other columns wide).

body:
Overflow only applies once a column can't wrap, so the first attempt wraps by design and `no_wrap=True` is needed for the ellipsis. To keep the other columns at their width, set `min_width` (or a fixed `width`) on them. The column options are described in the [tables docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/tables.rst). The squashing you see with `no_wrap` is related to #2890. For further usage questions, [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) is the right place.
